local_hybrid_support_review.decision: No net full-support gain: two improvements offset two full-to-partial regressions, plus two partial-to-missing regressions. Do not promote this hybrid configuration as superior to lexical retrieval on this book. Diagnose candidate versus reranker losses before tuning; results do not isolate the responsible stage.

rubric: Full means returned evidence supports the substantive question; partial means some needed explanation is absent. Reference defects are recorded separately, never silently corrected.

Fifteen baseline full answers not semantically regraded; original text containment alone does not prove unchanged answer quality. No full expanded-suite score. Manual non-blind review, reference uncertainties retained, no automatic runtime expansion enabled. No model calls or latency/generation-quality claim.

hometown_source_trace.answer_indexing_evidence: Chunk150 contains Nantes in Brittany and appears at rank37 for existing question3 in the same run, proving it was indexed and searchable. It is absent from question17's top100.
hometown_source_trace.context_evidence: Question17 rank1/chunk147 contains COLLOQUY WITH A STREETWALKER, Notebook and1787. Chunk150 has no heading metadata and contains conversation continuation without that identifying context.
hometown_source_trace.inference: This is candidate retrieval failure, not dropped parser text. Loss of section identity is a plausible contributor, not causally proven until controlled context enrichment is tested.
hometown_source_trace.limits: Existing raw passages inspected; no source upload, new inference, runtime change or full-suite score. Indexing proof comes from another query, not from modifying the failed question.

section_context_probe.method: Hand-selected source title/date prepended to chunks148–150 for indexing only; all1147 chunks and original_content/citations preserved. Fresh baseline and enriched lexical indexes; question17 unchanged.
section_context_probe.limits: Single-case oracle-context diagnostic after observing failure. No automatic heading extractor, no generalization or whole-suite quality claim. Source-derived label contains no hometown answer; other affected queries not evaluated. No runtime changes or paid calls.

automatic_section_context_probe.method: Detect uppercase PDF source-line titles and optional adjacent source/date, map all occurrences, prepend only to wholly contained chunks. Existing 30 queries, lexical retrieval, unchanged 1147 chunks and final5; no query-driven assignment.
automatic_section_context_probe.initial_failure: Unique-only title matching excluded body titles also present in the contents and propagated an unrelated contents heading across pages. Preserved in /tmp/rag-auto-section-probe.json. Do not use this variant.
automatic_section_context_probe.verification: All30 fresh baseline top5 ID lists match prior depth100 baseline. All300 returned original passages match source chunks. Automatically assigned correct title/date to148–150 and excluded cross-section147/151.
automatic_section_context_probe.limits: Post-hoc heuristic on one book, not a general parser. Nineteen top5 lists changed; their collateral relevance has not been regraded. Heading correctness not exhaustively reviewed. No runtime changes, paid calls or general quality claim. Harness evolved after initial failed variant; current fingerprint is recorded in repeated-title report.

automatic_context_collateral_review.method: Compare all19 changed ordered lists with baseline IDs; inspect every newly introduced passage and displaced evidence for affected partial/missing cases. Baseline grades retained as prior evidence, not silently replaced by a new full-suite score.

automatic_context_collateral_review.remaining_examples: Question7 still lacks career self-defense;11 lacks the distant book-title footnote;23 lacks the explanatory theological-legislation passage;25 lacks visibility/horse-transport details;28 lacks the continuation explaining consequences of victory. automatic_context_collateral_review.displacement: All eight changed baseline-full cases retain at least one previously identified supporting passage, but this is not proof every component remains supported. Question1 loses an explicit destiny-carried-out/fate-suffered contrast. Question21 loses a direct Duroc-affection passage. Do not claim zero quality regressions from ID overlap.
automatic_context_collateral_review.provenance_failure: Question5 added p232-233 carries heading context [Conseil d'état, 1806] despite original passage explicitly switching to [Conversation, 1818]. Question23 applies [Conversation, 1817] across excerpts explicitly dated April/May1806. Section-wide propagation of the first excerpt's date is misleading. J. CHRISTOPHER HEROLD also propagates as a section label across introduction pages, illustrating unvalidated uppercase-heading detection.
automatic_context_collateral_review.decision: Do not enable this heuristic in runtime. Separate structural section titles from excerpt-local date/source metadata, bound metadata at every source marker, and verify provenance before further quality comparisons.
automatic_context_collateral_review.limits: Assistant non-blind diagnostic on one lexical corpus. Three source-grounded gains, not a complete after-score or proof of no regressions. No new inference, API spending or runtime changes.

bounded_metadata_probe.method: Keep section title independent of metadata. Add only nearest preceding bracket with a1700s/1800s year within that section, and omit added date if chunk crosses any bracket. Every bracket stops previous metadata, including editorial inserts. Same30 queries,1147 chunks,lexical final5.
bounded_metadata_probe.verification: All30 fresh baseline ordered lists match prior diagnostic. Two known erroneous date prefixes on chunks761 and486 are now absent; section titles remain. Source-grounded gains persist: equality/distinctions rank2, hometown rank4, education rationale rank4.
bounded_metadata_probe.limits: Diagnostic-only, source-era-specific year recognition, no general date/source parser. All-bracket stopping loses valid metadata after editorial notes; nearest dated editorial brackets could still be mistaken for source markers. Ten ordered lists changed and were not fully regraded. Fixing two known errors does not establish comprehensive provenance correctness. No runtime changes or paid calls.
bounded_metadata_probe.decision: Keep runtime unchanged. Retain raw results for comparison; source-marker classification and general structural heading recognition remain unproven.

explicit_outline_probe.method: PDF get_toc titles located exactly once on their destination page; unresolved destinations act as barriers. Only wholly contained original chunks receive title context, with no excerpt date. Same1147 chunks,30 questions,lexical final5.
explicit_outline_probe.findings: Equality/distinctions remains rank2 and education rationale rank4. Hometown answer is absent from final5 despite correct source outline title on chunks148–150. Section title alone does not reproduce the title/date result.
explicit_outline_probe.limits: Single-book post-hoc lexical diagnostic, no full relevance regrade or runtime change. Outline hierarchy flattened; exact destination matching can miss split titles, and unresolved barriers lose context conservatively. Source titles avoid guessed date provenance but do not solve excerpt identification. No paid calls.
explicit_outline_probe.decision: Prefer explicit document structure over uppercase guessing for future parser work, but do not claim it solves the detached-evidence failure. Keep runtime unchanged pending implementation tests and wider relevance evaluation.

next: Explicit outlines provide source-grounded section identity; excerpt-local identity remains a separate unsolved problem. Avoid promoting the earlier book-specific date heuristic.
